ownership.quote: We are thrilled to officially announce Sail! We build infrastructure for long-horizon agents: inference served at unbeatable price-per-token for open models, plus sandboxes designed to run for days, weeks, or even longer.

stage.quote: We've raised $80M, with our seed led by @Sequoia and series A led by @KleinerPerkins.
stage.note: Company announced seed and Series A together on 2026-06-24 ("Seed + Series A: Sail raises $80M"); Series A (led by Kleiner Perkins) is the last priced round.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company blog post totals seed + Series A rounds

note: Sail Research (sailresearchco) is a San Francisco AI infrastructure startup co-founded by CEO Neil Movva (ex-NVIDIA, Apple, Together AI) and CTO Samir Menon (ex-Apple), Stanford classmates. It sells LLM inference (price-per-token for open models) plus 'Sailboxes', persistent Firecracker-VM sandboxes for long-horizon agents. Came out of stealth 2026-06-24 announcing $80M combined seed + Series A (seed led by Sequoia Capital, Series A led by Kleiner Perkins) at a reported ~$450M valuation (per secondary LinkedIn/press coverage, not confirmed on the company's own blog). No accelerator/incubator affiliation found; the YC companies page has no 'sail'/'Sail Research' listing matching this company. Distinct from 'sail.dev' (Coder) and ticker SAIL (SailPoint) which appear in unrelated search noise.
